jobstocker.title: JobStocker
jobstocker.description: A collaborative progressive web app for sharing job opportunities and tracking applications.
points: Contributed to a college-era project with a public repository.
The public implementation includes opportunity sharing and application-status updates.
Presented as earlier work, without claims of current usage, maintenance, or adoption.

nitdgp-qrcode.title: Academic credential verification
nitdgp-qrcode.description: An exploration of QR-based verification for academic documents.
points: Explored how document information could be represented and checked through QR-based interactions.
The linked public repository is a testing website, not an official NIT Durgapur service.
This is a research concept, not evidence of institutional deployment or a security guarantee.

ms-lists.title: Search prototype
ms-lists.description: An internship exploration of search over cached, structured information.
points: Compared approaches and evaluated platform constraints.
Produced a prototype and a recommendation, not a completed production feature during the internship.
The general lesson: test an assumption before investing in a more elaborate implementation.
